Definition: The type of bedding material. Options: sand, straw, sawdust, manure solids, or none.
Values: sand, straw, sawdust, manure solids, CBPB sawdust, none

Definition: Daily mass of fresh bedding added per animal per day (wet weight). Bedding mass is applied based on the total number of animals in the pen, and is not based on the stream proportion of the manure stream the bedding is assigned to.
Density of the bedding on a wet weight basis.
Bedding dry matter content as a fraction of total mass.
Bedding carbon content as a fraction of total mass.
Bedding phosphorus content as a fraction of total mass.
The proportion (0.XX) of the fresh sand added each day that is assumed to be removed by a sand separator, settling lane, etc. immediately following manure removal from the barn
